title: Start task with coding agent
statement: The system shall, after user confirmation, launch a Claude Code coding agent for a task in its story's component repository on a dedicated branch, briefed with the task, story, requirements and acceptance criteria, and stream its progress to the UI.
rationale: Lets a product owner hand a planned task straight to an agent while keeping the work traceable to requirements.

acceptance_criteria.text: For a run started from the UI, a confirmation dialog shows the component path, the branch name reqforge/TASK-NNNN and the full brief, and nothing runs until the user confirms; runs started by the agent queue are authorised by the user who turned the queue on
The agent runs via the local claude CLI in a git worktree of the component on branch reqforge/TASK-NNNN
The brief contains the task description and done_when, the story narrative, each linked requirement statement and acceptance criteria, and the trace tag convention
Agent progress streams to the task drawer and the user can cancel the run
When the run ends, the task shows its branch, commits and exit status, and the task status is never set to done automatically
Start with agent is disabled, with the reason shown, when the story has no component, the component has no path, or any task in depends_on is not done
Start with agent warns, before confirmation, about other in-progress tasks of the same story with unmerged agent branches and offers to add them to depends_on
